Sayılar Search Console'dakiyle aynı mı?: Are the numbers the same as in Search Console?
Sayılar aynı kaynaktan gelir ama toplaml: The numbers come from the same source, but the totals may not match. Google delivers data about three days late and hides rarely searched queries. The app shows the page total and the site total separately. A difference between the two is not a bug.
Uygulamayı internete açmam gerekir mi?: Do I need to make the app reachable from the internet?
Hayır. Uygulama yalnızca kendi bilgisaya: No. The app opens only from your own computer. It reads Search Console and Analytics data from Google. During an audit it crawls only the pages of the site you are auditing.
